integrity: Includes deterministic standalone integer Morse and symmetry verifier; seven exact 4-cycles, exhaustive acyclicity and integral boundary computations.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for one 21-vertex open-neighborhood complex; no general n formula, no integral degree-three symmetry module, no quotient integral topology. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed-equivalence risk.
title: Integral mixed-dimensional homotopy and full top symmetry of \(\mathcal N(T_7)\)
